preconditions.description: The size of the set S must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= s_i <= 10**6 for s_i in S)
preconditions.description: All elements in the set S must be positive integers not exceeding 10^6.

preconditions.expression: len(set(S)) == m and all(S[i] < S[i + 1] for i in range(m - 1))
preconditions.description: The elements of the set S must be unique and in strictly increasing order.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (1 <= n <= 4000 and all(1 <= a_i <= 10**6 for a_i in a))
postconditions.description: If no solution exists, output -1; otherwise, output a valid sequence of length n with elements not exceeding 10^6.

postconditions.expression: all(any(gcd(a_i, a_j) == s for s in S) for i in range(n) for j in range(i, n))
postconditions.description: The sequence must produce all elements of the set S as gcd values for some subsequence.
